summary.zh: 專精 Vue.js、Nuxt 與 Tailwind CSS，具工業設計背景，重視視覺細節與使用者體驗。曾獨立完成課程銷售平台前端，主導 Vue 2 升級至 Vue 3 與 Webpack 遷移至 Vite，並透過重構使載入速度提升約 3～5 倍。近期以 Raspberry Pi 建置個人 Homelab，運用 n8n 探索工作流程自動化。
summary.en: Frontend Engineer specializing in Vue.js, Nuxt, and Tailwind CSS, with a background in industrial design and a strong eye for visual detail and user experience. Independently built the frontend of a course sales platform, led the upgrade from Vue 2 to Vue 3 and the migration from Webpack to Vite, and refactored code to make pages load about 3–5x faster. Recently, I've been building a personal homelab with Raspberry Pi and exploring workflow automation with n8n.

description.zh: 在 LINE 群組一鍵報名羽球的機器人。身為羽球社團主揪，原本以文字接龍報名，常有人打錯格式；Dobby 取代接龍，並沿用原本記帳用的 Notion 當資料庫，不需另外架設。
description.en: A LINE bot for one-tap badminton sign-ups in a group chat. As the organizer of a casual badminton group, I replaced our copy-paste text sign-up chain, which kept breaking on formatting mistakes. Dobby uses the Notion workspace I already used for bookkeeping as its database, so there was nothing new to set up.
